title: Scholia on Euripides' Phoenissae / Схолии к «Финикиянкам» Еврипида
author: Anonymous; ancient and Byzantine (Moschopoulos, Thomas Magister) layers
edition: Mastronarde, EuripidesScholia.org, Release 4 (2026), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, which is compatible with Neoscholia's non-commercial licence. Schwartz 1887–91 is PD.
ru_evidence: No Russian translation found on ancientrome.ru or ru-wiki. Not specifically searched in Russian.
en_evidence: EuripidesScholia.org gives English translations for the Orestes scholia only; the Phoenissae scholia are untranslated.
value: Phoenissae was a Byzantine triad play with a rich Theban mythography and ancient staging notes. The openly licensed critical text with apparatus is ideal for publishing source and translation side by side.
ai_feasibility: High. Open digital text with structured scholia types; Mastronarde's Orestes translations offer a style benchmark.
